description: DiligenceOps: submit a counterparty’s data processing agreement or its key clauses, as text, fields (roles, purpose_limits, subprocessors, breach_notification, transfers, deletion_return) or both. The signed report marks the roles of the parties, purpose limits, sub-processor terms, the breach notification window, the transfer mechanism and deletion or return on termination present, missing, ambiguous or one-sided, with quotes: processing for the processor’s own purposes, sub-processors added at its discretion with no right to object, a breach window longer than 72 hours, transfers anywhere with no mechanism and copies kept after termination. POST /api/dpa-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send the agreement, the fields or both.

agreement.description: The data processing agreement or its key clauses as text or HTML, up to 256 KB.

fields.description: The same material as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the document for that element.

breach_notification.description: The breach notification clause and its window.

deletion_return.description: Deletion or return of the data on termination.

purpose_limits.description: The purpose limits and instruction clause.

roles.description: The roles of the parties, for example "Customer is the controller; Vendor is the processor".

subprocessors.description: The sub-processor terms: authorization, notice, objection and flow-down.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_dpa-evidence-check
title: DPA evidence check
